sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: No Limit to Perfection - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "It's not enough to just shoot from a distance, you've got to anticipate your enemy's moves! A lot of my guys rush it, starting blasting the moment they spot someone. And of course they miss! The whole point is careful aiming and understanding how your opponent behaves. I think you could use some practice too. Get to the Arena!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 100 enemies while aiming down sights

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +27,000 EXP
- +300 Attention skill points
- 20 GP coins
- 1× Valuables crate (Rare)
